items.title: Goldman's LCN Deal Extends Its Push to Scale AWM & Durable Revenues
items.summary: GS's LCN deal expands its AWM platform into private real estate, supporting recurring fees and a more capital-light revenue mix.

items.title: Can C Capitalize on Digital Asset Growth With New Custody Platform?
items.summary: Citigroup's new Custody platform launch expands its digital-asset strategy, linking custody, tokenized payments and institutional services to capture more transaction flows.

items.title: Anthropic-Tied Data Center Inks $1.3 Billion Private Credit Loan
items.summary: Eagle Point Credit Management LLC is providing a roughly $1.3 billion private credit loan for a sprawling AI data center in Texas tied to Anthropic PBC, giving the investment firm a key role in one of the latest jumbo financings fueling the artificial intelligence boom.

items.title: What Is Morgan Stanley (MS) Being Accused Of By A Former Advisor?
items.summary: Morgan Stanley (NYSE: MS) faces new allegations from former advisor Elizabeth Hobson of workplace discrimination based on gender and physical disability. Hobson claims managers applied inappropriate pressures, breached confidentiality, and denied her medical leave during her time at the firm. The allegations raise questions about Morgan Stanley's internal culture at a time of wider scrutiny of conduct in the financial sector. For investors tracking how workplace culture and governance...

items.title: Chinese Coking Coal Futures Soar as Shanxi Supply Crunch Worsens
items.summary: Chinese coking coal prices are surging as supply continues to tighten after the deadly accident in the mining hub of Shanxi three months ago.

items.title: Who’s Buying NIO Stock? Morgan Stanley Leads As Existing Holders Turn Net Sellers
items.summary: Morgan Stanley, UBS, Bank of America, Susquehanna and Millennium collectively added about 36 million Nio shares.

items.title: Ex-Morgan Stanley Advisor Alleges Firm 'Circled The Wagons' After Misconduct Claims
items.summary: In a lawsuit, Elizabeth Hobson claims the wirehouse disclosed her confidential address, took away client relationships, and subjected her to investigations after she reported discrimination from her managers.

items.title: 4 Highly Rated Vanguard Dividend and Income Funds
items.summary: These four low-cost Vanguard dividend and income funds have all earned high praise from Morningstar, and they offer attractive yields.
